We are seeking a Senior Network Test Automation Engineer to design and implement automation solutions that integrate Robot Framework into CI/CD pipelines, connect automated testing workflows with TestRail, and develop reusable keyword libraries for complex network environments. This role is essential in driving efficiency, consistency, and scalability across our network validation and testing processes.
 Responsibilities
Integrate Robot Framework test suites into Git-based CI/CD pipelines for continuous validation
Automate synchronization between Robot Framework and TestRail for test case creation and result reporting
Develop and maintain a reusable keyword library for Robot Framework to support test engineers
Create automation scripts for interacting with home-grown automation stack via REST API, Cisco devices (XR and NX platforms), and Arista switches
Build automation for Avocent terminal servers, Ixia traffic generators, and Apcon Layer 1 optical switches
Automate test case generation from TestRail metadata
Report test execution results back into TestRail with full traceability
Define and carry out guidelines for keyword reuse and script standardization
Partner with QA and Network Engineering teams to ensure robust automation coverage
Contribute to the evolution of automation frameworks and libraries
Find opportunities to optimize execution time and improve test coverage
 Requirements
3+ years of experience in test automation engineering
Proficiency in Python and Robot Framework for test automation
Hands-on experience integrating automation with CI/CD pipelines (GitLab)
Familiarity with TestRail or similar test management tools
Deep understanding of network technologies and protocols (Cisco XR/NX, Arista, BGP), as well as VXLAN, ISIS, and QOS
Background in Linux environments and automation of network validation
Knowledge of Ixia, Apcon, and terminal server automation
Capability to develop reusable, modular automation libraries and implement coding standards
Excellent communication and documentation skills
English proficiency at an Upper-Intermediate level (B2) or higher
